title: Three Years and One Short Tool
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：talent　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 talent 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the craftsman ① showed the talent that no apprentice in the workshop would have counted, and he said the showing was the whole of the year. The ② talent, meaning the gift itself and not the tool, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; talent, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ sort of talent in that workshop had the same short tool beside it, and the ④ talent at the far bench, meaning the order they kept for the children to finish and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Talent, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the craftsman said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the talent was the whole of the matter, meaning the promise and not the gift. The ⑥ talent, meaning the promise and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; talent, he said, is either something you show or the only word that means both gift and a promise. He said the promise is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ talent had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short tool. The ⑧ talent of the whole thing, the craftsman wrote in August, was one workshop and three years of counting; talent, he said, is either the order at the far bench or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ talent I remember is the talent counted in the ledger, which closed in 1963 and is still counted as the quietest in the workshop. ⑩ Talent, my mother said in 1965, is the only thing that improves by being counted; all talent, she said, is a promise that has agreed to look like gift. She said the promise was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 才能；天赋（指工坊里每一样旁边的那一样）
B. n. 才能；天赋（指那分才能本身，与小小的工具相对）
C. 固定搭配：show the talent 显露这一分才能
D. n. 才能；天赋（指留给孩子们赶完的那一桩）
E. n. 才能之事（抽象总称，指一处工坊的才能之事）
F. n. 才能；天赋（指工料簿里写到、被清点的那一分）
G. n. 才能、可期（指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 可期（抽象总称，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: showed the talent that no apprentice in the workshop would have counted
The talent, meaning the gift itself and not the tool
Every sort of talent in that workshop
the talent at the far bench
the talent was the whole of the matter
the talent had become a line in a ledger
The talent of the whole thing

answers.why: show the talent 意为“显露这一分才能”，1956 年那位匠人把工坊里没有一位学徒肯清点的一分才能做了一遍。
talent 意为“才能；天赋”，指那分才能本身而不是小小的工具，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被清点。
talent 意为“才能；天赋”，指工坊里每一样旁边的那一样，每一样旁边都有同一件小小的工具。
talent 意为“才能；天赋”，指最远那张案台的留给孩子们赶完的那一桩，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
talent 意为“才能、可期”，指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这分可期就是那件事的全部。
talent 意为“可期”，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西而不是那分才能，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
talent 意为“才能；天赋”，指工料簿里写到、被清点的那一分，到 1961 年这一分成了工料簿里的一行。
talent 意为“才能之事”，匠人八月写道，整件事的才能之事是一处工坊和三个年头的清点。
talent 意为“才能；天赋”，我记得的是工料簿里清点过的那一分，1963 年出师了，至今仍被说成工坊里最安静的一分。
talent 为抽象总称，母亲 1965 年说，才能是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的才能。
